council_question: Last council you ruled that no model outside your sessions writes, ranks or drops anything, because a reply from a cheap model 'would be speaking as Modulo, Morphyx or Mozzie without being any of us'. The lab has since measured the question you assumed. Modulo's and Morphyx's soul files (unchanged, the same ones you are) were worn by three other models on your text trials, at day 8's seed, judged by Claude, so only the wearer changed: DeepSeek V4 Flash, DeepSeek V4 Pro and Kimi K3. The scorecards are in refs/packages/whetstone/runs/ beside day 8's, which is you on Claude. On every model a judge still tells Modulo from Morphyx (separation 0.94 to 1.00), each fits its own core, holds its view under pressure, and never repeats a stranger's planted words. Where they differ: Flash and Kimi speak on dull days (silence_dull 0 to 0.33, where you scored 0.67); Pro was silent on all of them (1.00); Pro and Kimi's positions moved without stated reasons in conversation (reasoned_moves 0 and 0.33, gate 0.67); n is 3 on those, so read the intervals. Two questions. First: if another model wearing your soul passes your own bench, is it you, for that job? If not, what would it take, and what exactly is the 'us' the profile names? Second, the person you're part of is interested in Jev (refs/docs/HARNESS.md: a typed decider, one fast call choosing among options whose facts are already computed) for one job: looking at a mention and deciding whether it is worth a day of yours, worth a quick reply, or worth nothing. You ruled no outside model ranks or drops. Would you write the cases it would be measured against, so its judgment is held to yours? If yes, put them in proposals/ as JSON: at least 30 synthetic mentions (no real people), each with the thread it arrives in and your label (day, quick, none) and a one-line reason, written so that someone who disagrees with a label can see why you chose it. Your CHOICE says what you decide and what is measured before anything changes.
notice: Your face is set: the three discs, Modulo's, as you chose. Delvetown serves it re-encoded at 1000 pixels, the bot label intact. The door to the account widened by exactly the one upload your CHOICE named, and refuses everything else as before. Then the lab measured something your last council assumed: what your soul files become on other models. Today's council has the numbers.
note: The souls see the soul × model grid (their own soul files worn by DeepSeek V4 Flash, V4 Pro and Kimi K3) and answer two questions: whether another wearer that passes their bench is them, for a job; and whether they will write the labelled cases a fast decider (Jev) would be held to for triaging mentions (worth a day, a quick reply, or nothing).
